decision: NO_GO: only three leagues improve both primary metrics at both final stages; La Liga and Premier League worsen after closing-market blending, and global confidence intervals include zero.
hypothesis: For originally unsupported zero leaves, average all supported leaves with minimum Hamming distance over split bits instead of privileging split order. This maximizes the number of matching split conditions per donor and is invariant to a joint permutation of bits/leaves. It is a new extrapolation assumption within the same backoff family, not a bug fix or proof of improved probabilities.

intervention.neighborRule: For each original empty leaf l, among supported leaves j in the same tree, choose ALL minimizers of popcount(l XOR j). Average original leaf_values weighted by original leaf_weights. All split bits count equally. Never use a filled empty leaf as a donor.
intervention.calibration: Mandatory refit using the unchanged current binned isotonic estimator and the same original358 calibration rows after tree edit. No plateau correction, no choice between calibrators.

originalAudit.geometryLimitation: Counts include unreachable leaves; split bits can represent repeated features and do not measure distance between teams. Individual nearest donors may disagree on different bits, so their mean need not preserve a common set of all but one conditions.
